description: PREORDERS START TO SHIP OCTOBER 9TH. Limited Quantities on initial shipment.Our most anticipated launch since the viral Motor Goat V3. Also Includes Kinetic Energy Recovery to recharge the battery. Works like Regenerative Braking but isn't limited to just braking.
